title: A Skunk Can Fire Two Jets of Spray From Ten Feet Away

scenes.text: A skunk won't spray you without warning. It tries three other things first.
It arches its back, raises its tail, then stamps its front feet.
If you ignore that, two tiny nozzles extend and fire spray, each one aimed on its own.
It can hit anything about ten feet away, even if it has to spray backward.
The smell is a sulfur chemical, and people can notice it from about half a mile away.
The glands can take days to refill, so a skunk saves it for last. Warning first. Spray second.

description:
A skunk gives three warnings before it fires.
It can aim two spray jets on its own from about ten feet, and the smell travels half a mile.
Would you have noticed the warning in time? Comment below.
first_comment: Skunks warn first and spray last. Which animal gives the clearest warning?
